title: torch
content: 记录一些torch接口 | last modified: 2025/07/08 torch::empty_like(torch::Tensor) 创建一个和输入张量形状、数据类型、设备完全相同的空张量（未初始化，内容随机） auto out = torch::empty_like(q); torch::Tensor.options() 获取张量的所有属性（如 dtype、device、layout 等），方便后续创建属性一致的新张量 auto opts = q.options(); torch::empty() 创建一个形状为 [batch_size, num_heads, seqlen_q] 空张量，指定数据类型为float32，其余属性和opts保持一致 auto softmax_lse = torch::empty(batch_size, num_heads, seqlen_q, opts.dtype(torch::kFloat32));

title: c
content: last modified: 2025/07/08 c++ 命名空间 namespace flash ... 让大括号内的内容都归属于 flash 命名空间，调用时需加前缀 flash:: C++ 的命名空间namespace可以在多个文件中多次声明和扩展。 只要你在不同文件中都写 namespace flash ... ，这些内容都会被合并到同一个 flash 命名空间下。 这样你可以在不同的 .h、.cpp、.cu 文件中为 flash 命名空间添加函数、类型、变量等。 lambda表达式 //将x向上取整到m的倍数auto round_multiple = [](int x, int m) return (x + m - 1) / m * m; ;round_multiple(130, 128);// return 256 宏定义技巧 #define CUDA_ERROR_CHECK(condition) \ do \ cudaError_t error = condition; \ if (error != cudaSuccess) \ printf( \ CUDA_CHECK error in line %d of file %s \ : %s , \ __LINE__, \ __FILE__, \ cudaGetErrorString(error)); \ exit(EXIT_FAILURE); \ \ while (0) 这是C/C++中常见的宏定义技巧，do ... while (0) 的作用是让宏在任何上下文下都能像一条普通语句一样安全地使用 如果只写： #define CUDA_ERROR_CHECK(condition) \ cudaError_t error = condition; \ if (error != cudaSuccess) \ printf( \ CUDA_CHECK error in line %d of file %s \ : %s , \ __LINE__, \ __FILE__, \ cudaGetErrorString(error)); \ exit(EXIT_FAILURE); \ \ 当你在if语句等复合语句中使用时，可能会出现语法错误或逻辑错误 if (flag) CUDA_ERROR_CHECK(cudaMalloc(...));else do_something(); 如果宏没有 do ... while (0) 包裹，展开后可能变成： if (flag) ...else do_something();

content: CUTLASS实践 | last modified: 2025/07/07 Reference cutlass dochttps://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/media/docs/cpp/quickstart.html cutlass bloghttps://developer.nvidia.com/blog/cutlass-linear-algebra-cuda/ cutlass blog(translate)https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/461060382 Efficient Matrix Multiplication on GPUs 对博客CUTLASS: Fast Linear Algebra in CUDA C++中同名章节做一个总结 Practice GEMM // Device function to compute a thread block’s accumulated matrix product__device__ void block_matrix_product(int K_dim) // Fragments used to store data fetched from SMEM value_t frag_a[ThreadItemsY]; value_t frag_b[ThreadItemsX]; // Accumulator storage accum_t accumulator[ThreadItemsX][ThreadItemsY]; // GEMM Mainloop - iterates over the entire K dimension - not unrolled for (int kblock = 0; kblock K_dim; kblock += BlockItemsK) // Load A and B tiles from global memory and store to SMEM // // (not shown for brevity - see the CUTLASS source for more detail) ... __syncthreads(); // Warp tile structure - iterates over the Thread Block tile #pragma unroll for (int warp_k = 0; warp_k BlockItemsK; warp_k += WarpItemsK) // Fetch frag_a and frag_b from SMEM corresponding to k-index // // (not shown for brevity - see CUTLASS source for more detail) ... // Thread tile structure - accumulate an outer product #pragma unroll for (int thread_x = 0; thread_x ThreadItemsX; ++thread_x) #pragma unroll for (int thread_y=0; thread_y ThreadItemsY; ++thread_y) accumulator[thread_x][thread_y] += frag_a[y]*frag_b[x]; __syncthreads();

content: 日本轻小说 | last modified: 2025/07/07 谁杀了勇者 卷1谁杀了勇者 卷2谁杀了勇者 誰が勇者を殺したか 勇者击败了魔王，同时──不再复返。魔王被打倒已过四年。为赞扬已逝勇者的诸多伟业，终获安稳的王国着手编撰文献的事业。然而访问勇者过去的伙伴──剑圣里昂、圣女玛莉雅、贤者梭伦──关于勇者的过往及历险记之际，所有人对勇者之死的真相皆含糊其辞。「为何勇者会死？」杀了勇者的究竟是魔王？抑或伙伴？这是一部交织着王国及冒险者们的业与情，令人目不转睛的奇幻悬疑群像剧。

content: last modified: 2025/07/05 basic dataclasseshttps://docs.python.org/zh-cn/3.12/library/dataclasses.html libs for ML transformers huggingface-transformershttps://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/zh/index 在Hugging Face Transformers库中自定义并注册模型 项目结构 my_transformers_model/├── setup.py├── src/│ └── my_model/│ ├── __init__.py│ ├── configuration_my_model.py│ └── modeling_my_model.py 模型配置 from transformers import PretrainedConfigclass MyModelConfig(PretrainedConfig): model_type = my_model # 必须与注册名称一致 def __init__( self, vocab_size=30522, hidden_size=768, num_hidden_layers=12, **kwargs ): super().__init__(**kwargs) self.vocab_size = vocab_size self.hidden_size = hidden_size self.num_hidden_layers = num_hidden_layers 模型实现 import torchimport torch.nn as nnfrom transformers import PreTrainedModelfrom .configuration_my_model import MyModelConfigclass MyModelPreTrainedModel(PreTrainedModel): config_class = MyModelConfig base_model_prefix = my_model def _init_weights(self, module): 权重初始化 if isinstance(module, nn.Linear): module.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=self.config.initializer_range) if module.bias is not None: module.bias.data.zero_()class MyModel(MyModelPreTrainedModel): def __init__(self, config): super().__init__(config) self.embeddings = nn.Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size) self.layers = nn.ModuleList([ nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, config.hidden_size) for _ in range(config.num_hidden_layers) ]) self.post_init() # 调用权重初始化 def forward(self, input_ids): embeddings = self.embeddings(input_ids) for layer in self.layers: embeddings = torch.relu(layer(embeddings)) return embeddings __init__.py from .modeling_my_model import ( MyModelConfig, MyModelPreTrainedModel, MyModel)# 注册到AutoClassesfrom transformers import AutoConfig, AutoModelAutoConfig.register(my_model, MyModelConfig)AutoModel.register(MyModelConfig, MyModel) \setup.py from setuptools import setup, find_packagessetup( name=my_model, version=0.1.0, packages=find_packages(where=src), package_dir=: src, install_requires=[ transformers=4.20.0, torch=1.10.0 ], python_requires==3.7,)
